Hon'ble Neeraj Tiwari,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed today, is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and Ms. Madhuri Singh,
learned counsel for the opposite party no.2.
3. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 1.6.2015 as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 212 of 2015, arising out of case crime no. 796/2014 under Sections- 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Modi Nagar, District- Ghaziabad,
pending in the court of Additional District and Session Judge/ Special Judge, POCSO Act,
Saurabh @ Soni vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129143846/
1 Ghaziabad.
4.

entities.text: Saurabh @ Soni vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that present matter is arising out of matrimonial dispute.
He next submitted that now applicant and opposite party no. 3 have solemnized the marriage and living together happily and out of their wedlock, they have been blessed with one child.
Therefore, present proceeding may be quashed.

5. Ms. Madhuri Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has not objected the aforesaid fact by filing counter affidavit and submitted that in case proceedings is quashed, he would have no objection.
6. In view of above, the applicants and opposite party no. 2 do not want to pursue the case any further as stated by them.
The matter has been mutually settled between the parties, therefore, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter further.

7. Thus in view of the well settled principle of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the matters of Krishnappa & Ors. vs. State of Karnataka; 2021 0 Supreme(SC) 529, Parbatbhai Aahir @
Parbatbhai Bhimsinhbhai Karmur and Ors. vs. State of Gujarat and another; 2017 9 SCC 641, B.S.
Joshi Vs. State of Haryana; 2003(4) SCC 675, Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Burea of Investigation and another; (2008) 9 Supreme Court Cases 677, Gian Singh Vs. Stated of Punjab; (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & others Vs. State of Punjab and another; (2014) Supreme Today 642, the proceedings of the aforesaid case is hereby quashed.
